paper_title: Morphological and Optical Engineering for High-Performance Polymer Solar Cells

knowledge_points.content: A polymer solar cell based on the PTB7-Th:PC71BM blend system achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 10.22% when processed with diphenyl ether (DPE) as an additive, compared to 5.93% for the device processed with pure chlorobenzene.
knowledge_points.evidence: The device with DPE achieves the highest device efficiency of 10.22%... The device prepared from pure chlorobenzene (CB) exhibited low PCE of 5.93% which resulted from poor JSC and fill factor (FF).

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of diphenyl ether (DPE) as a processing additive into the PTB7-Th:PC71BM active layer results in the smoothest surface morphology with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 0.976 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is noticeable that the film with DPE exhibited an even surface with the lowest RMS roughness of 0.976 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Incorporating a ZnO layer between the active layer and the Al electrode serves a dual purpose as both an electron transport layer (ETL) and an optical spacer, increasing the PCE from 10.22% to 10.81%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Additional ZnO optical spacers on the active layer controls the distribution of the electric field in the whole device and enhances the light absorption within the active layer, thereby improving device efficiency up to 10.81%

knowledge_points.content: The charge collection efficiency (Jph/Jsat) for PTB7-Th:PC71BM devices processed with diphenyl ether (DPE) is 96.3%, which is higher than devices processed with CN (95.4%), DIO (95.7%), or pure CB (89.3%).
knowledge_points.evidence: The charge collection efficiency (Jph/Jsat) of devices with CN, DIO, and DPE are 95.4, 95.7, and 96.3% , respectively, while Jph/Jsat of the control device... show only the 89.3

knowledge_points.content: The light-intensity dependence of short-circuit current (JSC) follows a power law (JSC ∝ P^α), where the DPE-processed device shows an α value of 0.94, indicating minimized nongeminate (bimolecular and trap-assisted) recombination compared to CB, ODT, CN, and DIO additives.
knowledge_points.evidence: The high JSC ~ 18.04 mA cm−2 obtained from the device with CB/DPE is consistent with a higher value of α (0.94) compared to other devices processed with CB, CB/ODT, CB/CN, and CB/DIO.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS measurements indicate that PTB7-Th pristine and BHJ films exhibit a dominant face-on orientation of polymer backbones, with pi-pi stacking distances ranging from 3.90 to 3.95 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: Pronounced pi-pi stacking peaks in out-of-plane direction were also observed regardless of additives, indicating dominant face-on orientation of polymer backbones. Resultant face-on stacking distances were around 3.90-3.92 A for all pristine polymer films with the exception of CN (3.95 A).

knowledge_points.content: Transfer matrix formalism is used to simulate the electric field distribution inside the device, revealing that a ZnO optical spacer is most effective at enhancing light absorption when the active layer thickness exceeds 140 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: By contrast, devices with t_active > 140 nm outperformed the device without optical spacer as a result of constructive interference... The calculated field profiles reveal that JSC reduction for the devices with t_active < 140 nm is attributed to the localization of electric field... right under the metal.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal thickness for the ZnO optical spacer in the PTB7-Th:PC71BM system is 30 nm, which allows for effective rearrangement of the electric field inside the active layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: On the basis of the simulated results shown in Figure S4b and Figure S5, t_ZnO = 30 nm and t_active = 190 and 280 nm were chosen as optimal conditions.

knowledge_points.content: Electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) shows that the introduction of a ZnO layer reduces the series resistance (Rs) from 34.5 to 30.5 Ω and the charge transfer resistance (Rct) from 23.9 to 15.4 Ω.
knowledge_points.evidence: The introduction of ZnO slightly reduced the Rs value from 34.5 to 30.5 Ω In addition, Rct values were measured as 23.9 and 15.4 Ω for the device without and with ZnO, respectively

knowledge_points.content: PTB7-Th has a bandgap of approximately 1.7 eV and maintains a cascade energy level structure with PC71BM and PEDOT:PSS, facilitating high performance in fullerene-based solar cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: PTB7-Th with a band gap of 1.7 eV has a cascade energy level structure between PC71BM and poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene)-polystyrenesulfonate (PEDOT-PSS)
